## Decisions for Glenn

Choices that change behavior, remove machinery, or touch repository and fleet settings.

### Cap the single-packet resend delay at timeout/4

Audit 16: with message_resend_delay_max_ms above reliable_message_timeout_ms/4, a single-packet record gets fewer than four sends before timeout. Recommended: cap it as chunks are. Then both resend classes share one delay, and the two resend queues could collapse to one; that removes machinery.

From: Audit item 16

### Wire version after removing type 9

The removal leaves ROCKETNET_WIRE_VERSION unchanged because no surviving packet changes a byte.

From: Audit item 13

### Unit tests and the process environment

Unit cases still reach the environment through the public creates, safe only because the runner clears every name the SDK reads. Stricter: route about 320 creates through the injected-environment variants. Recommended: keep the runner boundary. Also move the XDP gateway address read from socket open to create.

From: #794

### Branch protection on main

No ruleset requires any check on main (audit 44).

From: Audit item 44

### A runner label for the nightly frame budget held only by amd-2 and amd-3

rocketnet-quiet also covers hetzner2; the frame budget is a wall-clock gate that compares only on one machine class.

From: #731
